Name: Pumpkin Farmer
Author: Alkogen
Description:
[left]Yep. You're a pumpkin now.

Features
[list]
[*]Includes various plant vine tones![/*]
[*]In order, they are Pumpkin (twice), Sunflower, Fairy Rose, Green Bean, Powdermelon, Fiber, Crocus, Apricot (fall), Cherry (fall), and Peach (fall) leaves, straight from their respective color palettes. Things past Fairy Rose are new in 1.1![/*]
[*](new!) Hats lowered to fit on the small head.[/*]
[/list]Compatibility
[list]
[*]Should be compatible with anything that doesn't change the farmer, if something comes with some farmer changes, disable that in it's configs or disable it, or this if you prefer that one.[/*]
[*]Might have some issues with mods that add more animations to the farmer.[/*]
[/list]Credits
[list]
[*]Idea stolen from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6836]Fall Creatures[/url] by Undare, just changed a little. I disliked the way their Pumpking looked so I made my own without bothering to credit them, but at least I'm doing it now.[/*]
[/list][/left]
